title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.9.11
subtitle: Different material behavior across one cloth object.

highlights.title: Material Zones
highlights.description: Override stretch, bend, friction, shape damping and fold damping on selected faces. Other material controls inherit the object material.

highlights.title: Paint visible faces
highlights.description: Brush faces in the viewport, use Shift to remove them, and adjust the radius with the wheel. Enter confirms; Escape discards.

highlights.title: Exact triangle materials
highlights.description: Neighboring zones keep independent solver values even when their faces share vertices. Bake checks ownership and topology before export.
